meeting_point: The NW corner of State & Congress Streets outside 28 State Street (The Citizens Bank Building)
description:
Come explore the interesting streets, admire the architecture, and discover the history of downtown.  Hear stories that highlight Boston’s history and culture as we walk the Freedom Trail from Faneuil Hall to  Boston Common.  
 
This tour puts it all in context for you, from the time Boston was first settled to today’s quirky streets and mixed architecture!


##Tour Times

- Daily at 10am
highlights:
-  The Old & New State House     
-  Faneuil Hall           
-  Boston Massacre Site 
-  Park Street Church                   
-  King’s Chapel       
-  Old South Meeting House
-  Old Granary Cemetery             
-  Old City Hall and First Schoolhouse Site
-  The Old Corner Bookstore       
-  Boston Common  
-  The Irish Famine Memorial
